name: @dsh-toolset/context-report
description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 进程内集成插件：会话累计 token/上下文压力报告（sessionContext 投影 + context_report 工具）

scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf ../tmp/cov-context-report && mkdir -p ../tmp/cov-context-report && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=../tmp/cov-context-report node --experimental-transform-types --test 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/integration/*.test.ts' && node ../dev/coverage/report.mjs tmp/cov-context-report tmp/cov-context-report/report.json
